title: Selected Topics in Biology; Advanced Physiology
description:
(Sponsoring Dept: BIOL). Applicable towards Biological Sciences Specialization Area: GENB and PHNB.

Prerequisite: Permission of the department.

For students who have completed BSCI440 Mammalian Physiology and want to explore how organ systems are designed to solve fundamental physiological problems. Diverse examples, from comparative physiology to clinical cases, will be considered to illustrate basic principles of systems physiology.
